newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT to interconnect with Manila firm.
newsitem.headline: PLDT to interconnect with Manila firm.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co and Bayan Telecommunications Holdings Corp (BayanTel) said on Monday they had arrived at a short-term solution to the interconnection problem between their subscribers.

BayanTel executive vice-president Primitivo Penaranda told Reuters that PLDT senior vice-president Nestor Virata agreed last week to provide 75 interconnecting trunks, or 2,250 lines, to Bayantel within the month and another 75 trunks in October.
Under an earlier interconnection pact, PLDT was supposed to provide 350 trunks to BayanTel by October.

"Although the interconnection problem is not 100 percent resolved, at least this is an indication that things are moving forward and our subscribers can get through PLDT lines with some degree of ease," Penaranda said.
BayanTel is owned by Benpres Holdings Corp, Nynex Network System Co, Telecom Holdings Co Ltd of Thailand, Chase Capital, and Hong Kong-based Asian Infrastructure Fund.
